standard_prerequisites.name: A perfect complex is pseudo-coherent, and the pseudo-coherent lifting lemma produces a bounded above complex of finite free modules over the affine scheme restricting to the object
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the lifting complex F^bullet with E isomorphic to its restriction.

standard_prerequisites.name: A perfect object on a quasi-compact open has finite tor amplitude [a, b], and the last kernel of a bounded above complex with flat restriction is flat by the cohomology lemmas
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the kernel sheaf K|_U = F is flat, hence finite locally free.

standard_prerequisites.name: The stupid truncation triangle of a complex, the splitting criterion for a distinguished triangle whose connecting map vanishes, and the vanishing of Ext out of a perfect object into a bounded quasi-coherent complex in bounded degrees
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the splitting P|_U = F[-r-2] plus E for r very negative.

core_obligations: Set X = Spec(A) and lift the perfect object E to a bounded above complex F^bullet of finite free A-modules using pseudo-coherence and the lifting lemma; by finite tor amplitude [a, b] of E pick r < a (proof lines 3534-3542).

The kernel K of F^r -> F^{r+1} restricts on U to a flat sheaf F, hence flat of finite presentation, hence finite locally free; then F -> F^r|_U -> F^{r+1}|_U -> ... is a strictly perfect complex on U representing E while P = (F^r -> F^{r+1} -> ...) is a perfect complex on X (proof lines 3546-3557).

Stupid truncations give the triangle P|_U -> E -> F[-r-1] -> (P|_U)[1]; the connecting map E -> F[-r-1] vanishes for r very negative by the Ext vanishing lemma, so the triangle splits and P|_U = F[-r-2] plus E, exhibiting F[-r] plus E as the restriction of the perfect object P[1] shifted (proof lines 3558-3567).
proof_roadmap: Lift E to a bounded above complex of finite free modules and pick the shift r from the tor amplitude (proof lines 3534-3542).
Identify the kernel sheaf as finite locally free and represent E by a strictly perfect complex which extends over X (proof lines 3546-3557).
Split the stupid truncation triangle for very negative r via Ext vanishing (proof lines 3558-3567).
